(c) pantry items, shopping lists, meal plans, saved, rated and cooked recipes, and creators you follow;

(b) sign-in data: IP address, device type and browser type;
(c) for meal reminders: notification token, device operating system, time zone and reminder history;
(d) technical connection data, including IP address.
